item.title: Learning English with TV Series
item.summary: A podcast host shares practical tips for learning English from TV series, including how to use subtitles.
item.transcript_text: Hi everyone, and welcome back to Learn on the Go. Today I want to talk about something lots of you asked about: learning English with TV series. I watched a lot of series when I was learning, and honestly, it helped me more than most of my textbooks. But there's a right way and a wrong way to do it. First, choose something you'd actually enjoy, not just something people say is good for learners. If you're bored, you'll stop after two episodes. Second, think about subtitles. At the beginning, it's fine to use subtitles in your own language. But after a few weeks, try switching to English subtitles, so you start to connect the sounds with the words. And when you feel ready, turn them off completely for short parts, maybe five minutes at a time. Third, don't try to understand every single word, because that's really tiring. Instead, pick one or two useful phrases from each episode and write them down. So, here's my challenge for this week: watch one episode with English subtitles and note three new phrases. See you next time!
